description: Simulates DEX swap routes across liquidity pools, calculates dynamic price impact for trade sizes, and computes MEV/sandwich attack risk scores.

max_slippage_pct.description: Maximum acceptable slippage tolerance percentage. Defaults to 0.5%.

token_address.description: The ERC-20 contract address of the token to audit (e.g. 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 for USDC).

trade_size_usd.description: Simulated order size in USD to calculate dynamic slippage and price impact. Defaults to 1000.0.

name: dex_liquidity_router

alternative_routes.description: Secondary liquidity pools sorted by depth

execution_verdict.description: Trade suitability verdict (e.g., APPROVED_FOR_EXECUTION or REJECT_HIGH_SLIPPAGE)

optimal_route.description: Top liquidity pool with dynamic price impact and calibrated execution parameters
